name: liquid_ui (Premiere Deck copy)
forked_from: 3.1.0 (the shared Liquid UI kit)
owned_by_project_since: 2026-10-22
visual_spec: the shared kit 5.0.0 (type scale of named roles, density tokens, title bar, Scale control)

This copy of the Liquid UI kit belongs to Premiere Deck and is edited here. It is never synced from
or back to the shared kit (the app's design diverges: two project themes, the Sora text face, crystal
glass). It follows the shared kit's visual specification (the roles and sizes of the type scale,
the control heights, the title bar layout, the Scale setting) in its own files. Theme colours:
src/premiere_deck/ui/themes.json, rendered into css/themes.css by build/gen_themes.py.
